lee: Quick heads-up: onboarding sample emits INFO then later DEBUG with request-id — intermittent. likely OTEL hook ordering.
toni: Node sample? share startup order.
lee: Yes. require('redwood-sdk') -> configure logger -> init otel -> start server. env LOG_LEVEL=info.
toni: Prob race where request-id injector runs after first logs. Simple fix: early bootstrap logger + request-id fallback middleware at top of entry.
lee: Any redaction concerns? We saw emails in headers in DEBUG.
toni: Sample uses a weak regex. Recommend SDK redactHeaders or stronger pattern: (?:[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+)@(?:[A-Za-z0-9.-]+)\.[A-Za-z]{2,} .
qa: Also add a tiny integ test: start sample with LOG_LEVEL=info and assert no DEBUG lines before request-id present.
infra-bot: Opened devex/samples#4822 to track patch (bootstrap logger + req-id guard + improved redaction).
lee: I'll open PR with small patch + test.
toni: I'll review. Thanks!
